questions.question: Sheela celebrated her birthday on Wednesday, 10 April 2019. What will be the day of the week on her birthday in 2023?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

Sheela celebrated her birthday on Wednesday, 10 April 2019.

Days on these dates will be:

10 April 2020 → Friday

10 April 2021 → Saturday

10 April 2022 → Sunday 

10 April 2023 → Monday

Clearly, it will be Monday on her birthday in 2023.

Hence, ‘**Monday**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All classes are tools.

Some tools are nails.

No nail is a class.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some classes are nails.

(II) All tools are classes.

(III) Some nails are tools.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a445e4ac8fe2405cdbf4c965ca878c704edf86014c40a88de0c3f208bb269882.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some classes are nails. → Does not follow (As, No nail is a classes, so Some classes are not nails)

(II) All tools are classes. → Does not follow (As, All classes are tools, so some tools are classes)

(III) Some nails are tools. → Follows (As, Some tools are nails, so Some nails are tools)

Hence, '**Only conclusion III follows**' is the correct answer.

If 11 August 1918 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 4 December 1925?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 11 August 1918 is Sunday, then the day on these dates will be:

11 August 1919 → Monday

11 August 1920 → Wednesday

11 August 1921 → Thursday

11 August 1922 → Friday

11 August 1923 → Saturday

11 August 1924 → Monday

11 August 1925 → Tuesday

Number of days between 11 August 1925 to 4 December 1925 = (20 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 4) = 115

115 when divided by 7, leaves 3 as remainder.

Tuesday + 3 = Friday

Therefore, it will be Friday on 4 December 1925.

Hence, ‘**Friday**’ is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Given: 11 August 1918 is Sunday.

So, 11 August 1918 to 11 August 1925 = 7 Years (5 Ordinary and 2 leap Year)

In 7 years = (5 × 1) + (2 × 2) = 5 + 4 = 9 days.

And, from 11 August 1925 to 4 December 1925 = 20(Aug) + 30(Sept) + 31(Oct) + 30(Nov) + 4(Dec) = 115 days

Total days = 9 + 115 = 124 days → 124/7 = 17 week and 5 odd days.

So, 4 December 1925 = Sunday + 5 + Friday.

Hence. the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
